run_evaluation_from_pkl: run evaluation on 3D pose datasets by loading predictions from pickle files and computing MPJPE metrics
evaluate_h36m_protocol1: evaluate a trained HMR model on the Human3.6M dataset Protocol 1 using the evalfrompkl_hmr script
evaluate_3dpw_dataset: evaluate a trained HMR model on the 3DPW dataset using the evalfrompkl_hmr script
compute_mpjpe_metrics: compute MPJPE and reconstruction error metrics for predicted 3D human poses against ground truth
save_evaluation_results: save SMPL pose, betas, camera parameters, and predicted joints to a numpy .npz file
